allocation.final_process_observation: PID 1 gpu_worker.py serve --duty-cycle 0.60; PID 15396 cuda_load.py --duty-cycle 0.6; both confirmed live via kubectl exec ps after all jobs.

source.freeze_validation: All 15 listed final executable/dashboard files match the final frozen tree. The initial frozen tree differs only in the benchmark driver, before endpoint verification was added. Unit/Store jobs did not use that driver. Baseline has only the new benchmark driver over the baseline producer. Frozen sources were not overwritten while jobs used them; documentation was added later.

measurement_contract.clock: Host perf_counter wall time, including scheduling/GIL waits.
measurement_contract.completion: Attempts recorded only at return/exception. Retries count again; lifetime maximum is not a quantile. Queue wait can overlap other work.
measurement_contract.endpoint_verification: All four fields across all 13 stages match the actual multiprocess endpoint in all three instrumented capture-on phases, outside client timing.
measurement_contract.normal_workload_count_checks: Each instrumented phase has one completed attempt per published sample for normal stages, twice that for catalog_written and zero for recovery_read. All measured stage errors are zero.

benchmark.workload: seeded fixed-length random-ids, closed-loop concurrency, not production traffic
benchmark.timing: Client timing excludes warmup, server launch, readback and post-response writer drain
benchmark.payload_bytes: Validated manifest tensor sizes; not D2H or wire byte counters

scope.correctness: Actual inference regressions compare captured KV/teacher values with online observations. Benchmark snapshots validate metadata, content and digests after producer exit.
excluded: causal attribution of observed short-request p99 increase

summary.performance_conclusion: Short-request timed throughput is 4.07% lower, and p99 TTFT rises from 62.63/67.34 ms to 118.64/126.68 ms. Two short sequential repetitions cannot isolate instrumentation versus order/system effects. Negligible overhead and serving SLO acceptance are not established. Longer diagnostic lacks a baseline producer comparison.
summary.optimization_evidence: Construction/validation contributes 38.74% of measured short-request execution and 66.46% for longer sequences. These host measurements motivate profiling that work but do not predict an end-to-end speedup.

verification.ruff_imports_and_undefined_names: All 10 edited/new Python files pass I/F.
verification.dashboard: JSON parses; all 13 panel IDs unique. No live Grafana rendering claimed.
